why: The olive dress with the mint cardigan keeps everything in her green-and-yellow family and has no blockers. The one off-occasion flag is on o5, not here, so o4 sits at the formality her creative-office day asks for. I accept the green nubuck bag as the deliberate accent, with its loud chroma and small format, because it carries the texture the outfit needs and echoes the cardigan. I also accept the mixed registers and the light loafers, whose edge is quiet against skin, as a calm, seated-day look.
